explication: Argmax Open-Source SDK packages three on-device inference workflows: WhisperKit transcription, SpeakerKit diarization, and TTSKit speech generation, with a CLI and local transcription server as user-facing entry points. Shared ArgmaxCore handles model resolution/loading and tokenization. The graph follows documented workflows and relationships named by the SOURCE INDEX; unsampled implementation details are not expanded into speculative call chains.
